# GrowthBook <> Snowflake partnership
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 30m

## Summary
GrowthBook and Snowflake reviewed strong partnership momentum, with Snowflake consumption through GrowthBook growing more than 150% year over year, driven largely by Block. GrowthBook is currently in the Registered SPN tier and can pursue Select and Premier tiers, with technical validation remaining the primary blocker. Block usage is roughly ten times Sony and ClickUp usage, while expansion is expected at Sony and Block usage may at least double over the next year or so. Snowflake will provide a list of 65 customers using Snowflake through GrowthBook and help connect relevant sellers. Crossbeam coordination requires a mutual NDA, and a connected Snowflake Marketplace listing could enable capacity drawdown. GrowthBook will provide solution, architecture, win-story, and customer materials, review the AI-ready document, and pursue SPN validation. Vikas will share follow-up information, Marketplace instructions, account introductions, and the customer list.

## Keywords
Snowflake Partner Network, warehouse-native experimentation, SPN technical validation, Crossbeam co-selling, Marketplace Capacity Drawdown, Cortex Code

## Action Items
**GrowthBook team**
Apply for Snowflake Ready technical validation (11:42)
Upload GrowthBook sales overview materials (25:26)
Review AI-ready overview document (26:29)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Provide authorized Crossbeam NDA signatory details (13:34)

**Vikas Jain**
Send mutual NDA (28:15)
Introduce GrowthBook contacts to Snowflake sellers (28:22)
Provide GrowthBook Snowflake customer list (29:44)
Add GrowthBook contacts to shared Google Drive folder
Send written meeting summary
